config.label: Optional tag naming the MCP host this server runs under — e
config.description: Optional tag naming the MCP host this server runs under — e.g. claude-code, cursor, codex, copilot. It labels each estimate with where it came from, and on claude-code it lets the server say once when no automatic submission of a finished run has been recorded here. Free-form; defaults to "mcp" when unset.
